title: memory_ticket tool input
description: One call = 1 to 5 tickets. Only action, scope and text are needed; everything else is read as far as it is filled (a missing en, source or kind is not an error). The receiver is agentlas_cloud/memory_curation_v2.receive_tickets.

targets.description: ids of shown lines: rewrite 1, condense 2-8, remove 1 or more, add none

text.description: one sentence in the person's language

quote.description: the person's own words, when source is said

permission.description: true only when the line lets you act without asking the person next time (that is an approval, never a memory line: it is refused); leave it out otherwise, and whenever you are unsure

boundary.description: only with kind boundary: no_proactive (never message first) or quiet_hours (no first message from `from` to `to`, HH:MM local)
